title: York Space Systems First to Deploy Second Layer of T1TL Transport System, Confirms Health of 21 Additional Satellites on Orbit Within Hours
summary: York’s second production lot launch brings its total T1TL satellites on orbit to 42 York Space Systems (York) (NYSE: YSS), a leading, US-based national defense and commercial prime providing a comprehensive suite of mission-enabling solutions, has made contact and confirmed the healthy status of all 21 satellites in less than five hours following launch vehicle separation. The system was launched on July 16, from Space Launch Complex 4 East at Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA aboard a dedicated Falcon 9 in support of the Space Development Agency’s (SDA) Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) Tranche 1 Transport Layer (T1TL) mission.
